role: Interface for multi-part boss entities: the world the parts live in and the damage route that routes a hit on an EntityDragonPart into the parent's attackEntityFromPart.

notes: Only the dragon implements this interface in 1.7.10. The part positions are recomputed each tick in dragon.c's update_parts; the dev summon path reaches the same entry (dev.c cites EntityDragon.attackEntityFromPart). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): interface, marker or abstract base; its behavior lives in the subclasses' ports.
